title: you-do-not-need-importance
slides: You do not need importance; pendulums do. — Vadim Zeland
The heaviness on a goal is rarely the goal. It is the extra meaning stacked on it.
Trap: gripping harder and naming the strain discipline.
Give the pride back to the Higher Self. Keep the joy. Importance to zero.
Today: say the goal in smaller language. Slow the body around it.
